We need number of CH3 groups in the compound. But we have no description of compound. Possibly we need to infer from NMR? We have no SMILES. We could request proton NMR spectra? But we don't know the compound. Maybe the system expects we ask for proton NMR and deduce number of methyls from number of singlets around 0.9 ppm? Could be ambiguous.

Better to request proton NMR spectra for the sample at hand. Use tool proton_nmr_spectra (no input). Let's do that.
